study.question: Does the observed benefit of overlapping positional click routes reflect a larger effective primary update rather than complementary feedback representation, and does auxiliary learning in the new task-private route change that conclusion? Observation: g3-r0019-rank_collapsed_duplicate AUC0.666197844003692 versus collapsed_single0.6655081613932129 (delta0.0006896826104791); resolved duplicate/single0.666169816335156/0.6655022335039306 show the same pattern. The resolved-to-collapsed duplicate change is only +0.0000280276685360 in this seed. Source inspection shows identical features and kernels in the two collapsed click projections, zero initialization, and identical direct click gradients. The old auxiliary rows are detached and stay zero; new auxiliary rows learn separately. Latest knowledge usage was reviewed: declarations of DIN inheritance and consideration of hub/token architectures are provenance, not causal evidence for this route gain. The supplied trajectory index contains no execution failures; negative and abandoned scientific paths remain relevant: auxiliary live donor transfer in g3-r0012-redistrib_aux_live0.6630471075470955 underperformed self_live0.6633488027471348; shared positional gradient projection g3-r0017-position_gradient_project0.6641686829139023 underperformed primary-only0.665517949606882. These observations do not refute all transfer mechanisms. Initial DIN AUC0.6555440824200336 remains a reference, not a capacity-matched attribution control. Existing raw-data verification is host-owned under the frozen protocol; no raw data or tensor execution is exposed here.
study.hypothesis: The duplicate collapsed click branches primarily enlarge the effective AdamW change of the positional correction within an unchanged linear function space. Replacing their sum with one gain-two click correction should recover most of the measured duplicate-versus-unit-single advantage. Since these rows are task-private, auxiliary route learning has no direct derivative into click positional parameters; a large change in click from blocking auxiliary route learning would instead indicate consequential indirect training coupling. This is a provisional optimization/ownership explanation, not an established new representation mechanism.

study.proposed_difference: A 2x2 replacement/ownership factorial. Duplicate cells retain old click projection P and new rank projection R at unit gain; gain-matched single cells set the old contribution to0 and use2R for click only, leaving each auxiliary rank forward gain1. Independently, rank_aux_gradient=joint or primary lets auxiliary labels update their own new rank rows or detaches those route outputs. At fixed weights detachment preserves values; zero initialization makes all cells initially identical. No labels enter forward and no optimizer, gradients, global sample identity, data or scoring contracts are mutated. Both positional routines still run in every cell, so this is an attribution diagnostic rather than a compact-inference implementation. This extends g3-r0019 with a gain-matched replacement control; the single-unit-gain receipt remains an existing matched reference.
predictions: Concurrent rank_duplicate_live should reproduce parent validation AUC0.666197844003692 within1e-6 under the fixed deterministic host setup. A larger discrepancy triggers integrity review before interpreting this suite.

Before inspecting new outcomes, define practical click recovery as rank_gain_single_live within1e-4 AUC of rank_duplicate_live AND recovering at least75% of its advantage over existing unit-gain g3-r0019-rank_collapsed_single. This is a descriptive criterion, not a significance test or exact optimizer equivalence.

Expect the same within1e-4 duplicate-versus-gain-single closeness when auxiliary rank learning is blocked; primary function span remains identical. Report both contrasts and their difference of differences.

Because task-private rows prohibit direct cross-task updates, predict auxiliary-live versus blocked click effects and the factorial interaction to be below1e-4 in magnitude. Larger effects would motivate investigating indirect context/clipping coupling instead of treating labels as proven complementary.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values and auxiliary mean separately; select using full-population click AUC only. Report inherited history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 with samples, positives and negatives=samples-positives; avoid new validation-defined slices. Parent duplicate-minus-unit gain is concentrated in nonempty histories (about0.00036/0.00086/0.00076), while empty-history AUC changes indirectly despite no direct route.

Expected allocated total remains56,352,024 in every cell. Anticipate about525 seconds per full trial and comparable roughly7.13GB peak memory and38.7ms p50 model latency per batch8192 based on the parent, subject to host measurement; no cost improvement is predicted.
falsifiers: If the concurrent reproduction fails or host forward/backward/masking/label-order checks fail, classify integrity/execution trouble separately and do not interpret a predictive score as mechanism evidence.

If gain-two single fails either predeclared recovery criterion despite a valid duplicate control, the simple effective-gain explanation is insufficient. Investigate clipping/AdamW geometry or numerical effects before inventing complementary feature information.

If auxiliary blocking changes primary AUC by>=1e-4 or the replacement-by-ownership interaction is>=1e-4, the negligible-indirect-coupling prediction fails. This does not identify which indirect path causes the change.

If both parameterizations are similarly poor after blocking, the evidence would favor auxiliary-mediated training coupling as consequential, without establishing transfer semantics. If both remain similar to live, learned auxiliary rank routes are unnecessary for this particular click gain.

One seed meeting a descriptive threshold gives provisional local support only. A general mechanism or robust improvement requires additional paired seeds and an admissible diagnostic of the remaining clipping confound.
alternative_explanations: Single gain-two route has gradient2g while duplicate click rows each have gradientg at matched states. Its raw positional squared gradient norm is4||g||^2 versus2||g||^2. Frozen dense global clipping can therefore change every dense update. AdamW epsilon and floating-point arithmetic also prevent an exact optimizer-equivalence claim.

Auxiliary detachment changes learned auxiliary routes and dense clipping, with possible indirect effects through shared context, BatchNorm statistics downstream, and the fixed training trajectory. It does not isolate semantic complementarity or all negative transfer.

Allocated parameters and function span are matched for the primary correction; active parameter count and optimizer state usage differ. No equal-compute or efficiency conclusion follows until cost is measured.
This is exploratory single-seed validation after many adaptive choices; repeated deterministic parent reproductions are integrity checks, not independent repetitions.

Identity collapse does not remove all historical feedback information: total overlapping feedback mass, exposure and target matches remain. Similar resolved/collapsed outcomes cannot prove feedback tasks interchangeable.

Offline historical action visibility may include feedback unavailable at serving time; auxiliary labels match user/category/brand within24h, not advertisement-specific conversions. Results remain limited to this benchmark.
